components.summary: Read map and target contracts, static rules, finite ports and the canonical test tree with file-validated duration inputs. Own shared static call-graph reachability and model selection.
responsibilities: load, validate and save the map, fingerprints and current-model digests; memoize only parsed contracts by source identity
resolve component parents in one layer without loops
merge the target overlay, validate its remove intents and compare it with current
compute component fingerprints that detect stale descriptions and identify formula edits without a corresponding format change
register contract models, build the model tree and locate siblings whose parent projection ignores a newly received value
count import-like strings and injected attribute calls as dependency evidence
Reuse component file matches, test calls and read-only model trees for identical content within one command, returning fresh mutable call/file collections.
